name: Defensive Duelist
summary: +1 Dex; while holding a Finesse weapon, use a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to AC against melee attacks.

benefits.name: Parry
benefits.summary: Reaction when hit in melee while holding a Finesse weapon: +PB to AC against melee attacks until your next turn.
benefits.text: If you are holding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armor Class, possibly causing the attack to miss. The bonus applies against melee attacks until the start of your next turn.
